name: Dwarikesh Sugar Industries Limited
about: Dwarikesh Sugar Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of sugar in India. It is also involved in the co-generation and sale of power; manufacture of industrial alcohol, molasses, and ethanol; and production of hand sanitizers and liquid carbon dioxide. The company was formerly known as Dwarka Sugar Limited and changed its name to Dwarikesh Sugar Industries Limited in April 1994. Dwarikesh Sugar Industries Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India.
